name: LoopInterchange
description: Reorder nested loops to improve memory access patterns and cache locality by transforming strided accesses into unit-stride patterns.

parameters.name: loop_band
parameters.description: Tag or name identifying the loop band (set of consecutive loops) to interchange. For linalg operations, typically the outermost parallel or sequential loop nest.

parameters.name: permutation
parameters.description: List of integers representing the new loop order. For example, [0, 1, 2] is identity; [1, 0, 2] swaps the first two loops. Length must equal the number of loops in the band.
